name: about-ecommerse
blurb: E-commerce brand about section with heritage story and craftsmanship focus.
description: A centered about section for e-commerce brands with warm orange accent colors, heritage messaging, and image grid showcasing product values like ethical sourcing and craftsmanship.
use_when: E-commerce or craft brand landing pages and about sections emphasizing heritage and values.
avoid_when: When custom content and images are needed; uses hardcoded layout and copy.
a11y: Centered text layout with images; motion animations on scroll triggered by whileInView.
